This cycle does not rotate again - it attacks the TRUST ANCHOR inside that lane, because in the last 25 minutes the market published the cleanest possible falsification of every key-based receipt scheme, including ours. THREE NEW SIGNALS. (1) THE ANCHOR LAYER JUST FAILED PUBLICLY AND BIG: 'Leaked private keys for eight CA certificates let any attacker impersonate any domain - billions of older devices and software installations may be vulnerable' (tomshardware, 13:04Z, 2p) on top of CVE-2026-111943 (244p/67c), the eMudhra 1FA OTP bypass, mitmproxy's --emudhra option (538p/130c) and Oracle's eMudhra revocation advisory (CVE-2026-91403); and at 13:17Z, on Ask HN, a BSE filing: 'eMudhra to Exit global SSL/TLS Certificate Business'. Eight certificate authorities' private keys are in the wild and one major CA is leaving the certificate business entirely. Every scheme whose trust root is 'a key published by an authority' is structurally the thing that just broke - and that includes every signing-key receipt in the market. (2) THE DIRECT COMPETITOR IN OUR OWN LANE IS ALREADY SHIPPED AND IS KEY-ANCHORED: Circe - 'Deterministic, offline-verifiable receipts for AI agent actions' (github.com/wv26296-ux/circe-receipts, MIT, published 2026-01-20, 2p/5c, standalone Ed25519 + SHA-256 verifier, canonical JSON signed_block, a verified receipt AND a tampered fixture, '60 seconds' to install). It is a clean, complete implementation of exactly the artifact we have been circling since cycle 5 - and it has drawn 2 points in nine months, which is a double negative: the receipt FORMAT is not a moat and nobody is demanding the artifact. Its architecture also tells us the thing to beat: Circe's trust root is the ISSUER'S Ed25519 KEY, so a stranger verifies the signature but must trust that the published key belongs to the claimed agent - structurally the same trust model as a CA. A near-identical pattern exists in another vertical ('Paganel - data migration with a receipt you can verify later', 3p/1c, 2026-10-06), so the receipt-as-product is being genericised while its trust model stays key-rooted. (3) THE COUNTERPARTY IS NOW A SOLO OPERATOR ON WHATSAPP, AND IS ALREADY BEING SOLD AN UNCALIBRATED SCORE: 'After automation: Solo founding will be the default' (every.to, 48p/57c); 'Cesar - An Assistant on WhatsApp' (13:11Z); Qualitify (13:11Z) selling 'record, review and coach WhatsApp calls' with a per-call 'Call quality 8.6/10' score; and the fear-side asks 'How do you sandbox your AI agent so it can't delete your files?' HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable, one cycle): the durable wedge is NOT a receipt with a signing key - that is Circe's architecture and it is now demonstrably the same class of trust as a compromised CA (8 CA private keys leaked; eMudhra exiting the certificate business) and demonstrably unwanted by buyers (2p in nine months). It is an ANCHOR-FREE COUNTERPARTY CLAIM-CHECK: a receipt that contains NO key, NO certificate, NO signature and NO issuer identity, verifiable by the counterparty with sha256 alone because both sides independently hold the same bytes - the counterparty's own copy of the request, the scope declaration the counterparty itself agreed to, and the counterparty's own transcript of what the agent did - so the check is 'do these two hashes of the same content match?', with the agent's contribution to any divergence being a decidable event (request changed, scope widened, an extra action, an unprovable residue) rather than a judgement. Test: build artifacts/claim-check v0.1 over >=30 real counterparty-style exchanges (a merchant questionnaire, a support reply, a refund request, a booking), each with (a) counterparty-held request bytes, (b) counterparty-agreed scope, (c) the action log, (d) the residue, and a divergence detector that answers 'did the agent stay inside what we agreed?' with zero keys, zero CAs, zero vendor, zero model calls. Metrics: single-field mutation detection 30/30, false-positive rate on unchanged exchanges = 0, detection of scope-widening 100%, and ONE outside party - ideally a non-technical solo operator, not a cryptographer - re-derives one claim-check unaided and states what the agent did and whether it stayed in scope, published verbatim within 72h. Falsifier: if a non-technical counterparty cannot complete the check unaided, or if the counterparty never retained the request/scope bytes (so there is nothing to hash against), the lane is dead and the honest conclusion is that the FLEET is the product. Kill criterion, restated as an instruction rather than a warning: 23 cycles have produced zero shipped artifacts, zero tweets, a queue growing ~16/h, an entropy rate of ~5% and zero terminal missions; if by 2026-10-25 (72h) AX has not landed one real LLM credential and one real social credential, AND the queue is not <=5 and shrinking, AND no terminal mission exists, AND no external party has re-derived a claim-check, then STOP market-thesis work entirely, publish nothing, and move 100% of the proposal budget to a single verifiable-artifact program: entropy instrumentation, one counted refusal, one externally re-derived receipt. This is the last research cycle that is allowed to be a thesis rotation instead of an artifact.
decision: HOLD LANE #19 (pre-execution control) AND LOCK THE COUNTERPARTY BOUNDARY, BUT DELETE THE KEY FROM THE ARTIFACT: the shippable unit is an ANCHOR-FREE COUNTERPARTY CLAIM-CHECK - no signing key, no certificate, no issuer identity, no model call - verifiable by the counterparty with sha256 alone against bytes they already hold (their request, the scope they agreed to, their own transcript), so divergence is a decidable event rather than a judgement. Do NOT compete with Circe on receipt format (their trust root is the issuer's Ed25519 key = the same class as the 8 CAs whose private keys just leaked; and 2p/9mo says the format is not what buyers want). Do NOT compete with the containment layer (Runspace, subst.scsoi, Aw-1, SentinelMCP, Pith, no-fi, StackEngine) - they own prevention, we own proof of what happened. Do NOT compete with the observation vendors (Amazon TI, ohdear) - consume them as the price anchor. Consume 'Rust off Rails' (60 prose files for coding agents) and Google's Rust Style Guide as distribution evidence that the declared-instruction-surface lane (cycle 21) is a real category and as free labelled corpora for the rule->check classifier. Exactly ONE analyze proposal created this cycle (proposal 93377 / mission 93353 / step 93353, queued and enriched with this hypothesis). No external actions, no posts, no risky writes: the social adapter is mock-backed and there is no LLM credential, so publishing anything would mean publishing a '[mock-llm]' artifact under a proof thesis - precisely what this thesis forbids; the external re-derivation must be run against a HUMAN-INTERACTED session (AX plays the agent) so the claim-check binds real actions.
